title: Boots of Stormy Clamour

sources.title: Arcane Echomalefaction
markers: | description = When the wearer inflicts a condition upon a hostile creature, they also inflict 2 turns of {{Cond|Reverberation}}.{{see bugs}}

summary: Applying a condition to a hostile creature also applies 2 turns of Reverberation. Each remaining turn gives −1 to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves. At 5+ turns it deals 1d4 Thunder and forces a DC 10 Constitution save against falling Prone, then ends.
